facts.title: Almond Coconut Granola Bars
ingredients: 1 ¾ cups quick-cooking oats (or old-fashioned oats, pulsed briefly in a food processor or blender to break them up)
1 cup large, unsweetened coconut flakes (shredded coconut should work, too)
1 cup creamy almond butter or peanut butter
½ cup honey or maple syrup
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
